visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a completed dish featuring pork slices, onions, and greens in a savory sauce. The camera then cuts to a close-up of a person's hands using chopsticks to add thin, marbled pink pork slices into a black frying pan containing white onions and coiled konjac knots. (2) A shot transitions to a glass bowl where a dark brown sauce is being prepared. A hand stirs the liquid with a metal spoon, revealing suspended white sesame seeds. A graphical red clipboard overlay appears to list ingredients. (3) The cooking process starts as white shimeji mushrooms are poured into a clean, dry frying pan. Wooden chopsticks are used to spread the mushrooms evenly across the textured surface. (4) Sliced white onions are added to the pan with the mushrooms and are tossed around to integrate. (5) Clear water is poured into the pan, followed by the dark brown sesame-infused sauce from the glass bowl. (6) Translucent, greenish-blue konjac knots are added to the simmering mixture, followed by more fresh pork slices and vibrant green bok choy stalks. (7) The final phase shows the finished meal, glistening with sauce, being plated into a white bowl, garnished with fresh green onion shreds under bright studio lighting.
